stages.name: prepare
stages.description: Build exact-source connected components and frozen grouped folds.

stages.name: source_audit_gate
stages.description: Fail unless exact videos, transcript hashes, and components are fold-safe.
stages.gate_description: Require status=passed, validation_passed=true, zero cross-fold video IDs, zero cross-fold transcript hashes, and directly validate outer/inner group integrity.

stages.name: dummy_prevalence_baselines
stages.description: Generate trivial and training-fold-prevalence OOF reference rows.

stages.name: logistic_regression_smoke
stages.description: Run the full Logistic Regression benchmark as the cheap pipeline smoke test.

stages.name: random_forest
stages.description: Run Random Forest only after the LR smoke artifacts pass validation.

stages.name: xgboost
stages.description: Run XGBoost after the LR-first smoke gate.

stages.name: deep_dataset
stages.description: Build the source-grouped deep-text JSONL and chunk audit table.

stages.name: deep_dataset_audit_gate
stages.description: Verify deep rows, chunks, folds, groups, and frozen manifest hashes.
stages.gate_description: Require one deep-text record per perfume, exact outer-fold agreement, source-group preservation, and zero exact-source cross-fold counts.

stages.name: bert
stages.description: Run BERT on the audited source-grouped deep-text dataset.

stages.name: bilstm_attention
stages.description: Run BiLSTM + Attention after the BERT stage.

stages.name: source_grouped_diagnostics
stages.description: Generate rare-label, component-weighted, and cluster-bootstrap diagnostics.

stages.name: final_thesis_export
stages.description: Export the validated five-model comparison using thesis-facing terminology.

stages.name: final_audit_gate
stages.description: Verify all five models used the same frozen source-grouped manifests.
stages.gate_description: Require complete artifacts and OOF fold agreement for all five models, matching outer/inner/audit hashes, and complete comparison-table rows.
